title: Store agent memory in a local SQLite database
description: All facts and decisions live in one local SQLite file owned by the user.
reasons: The owner can inspect and back up the file directly
alternatives_rejected: Hosted vector database: adds an account, a network dependency, and a third party holding the memory

title: Keep facts bi-temporal instead of overwriting in place
description: A changed fact closes the old value's validity window and opens a new one; nothing is deleted.
alternatives_rejected: Overwrite in place: simpler, but destroys the record of what was believed before

title: Resolve cross-agent fact conflicts by owner ruling only
description: When two agents record different values for the same fact, the disagreement opens a conflict that only the owner resolves; no agent's version wins automatically.
reasons: A machine's version never silently wins
The ruling stays on the conflict record permanently
effects: conflicts queue added to the hub
